title: Customer lifetime value ranking
statementMd:
Rank customers by lifetime value (non-cancelled revenue) with `DENSE_RANK`. Show rank, name and value rounded to 2 decimals. Order by rank then name.

Expected columns: `rank`, `name`, `ltv`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH s AS (SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status <> 'cancelled' JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id) SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS rank, name, ROUND(total, 2) AS ltv FROM s ORDER BY rank, name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
